root_cause: The external LED circuit is connected to D8 while the sketch drives D9.
fix: Move the resistor connection to D9, or change lamp to 8.
how_to_see_it: Start simulation and watch the external LED for several seconds.

root_cause: GPIO18 and ground are on the two ends of contact 1, which is permanently connected.
fix: Move the ground wire from button:1.r to button:2.l.
how_to_see_it: Start simulation, release and press the button; the message never changes.

root_cause: The LED cathode faces the output and its anode faces ground, reverse-biasing the LED.
fix: Connect r:2 to led:A and led:C to ground.
how_to_see_it: Start simulation and observe that the external LED stays dark.

root_cause: The HC-SR04 TRIG and ECHO wires are crossed relative to the sketch.
fix: Connect TRIG to D6 and ECHO to D7.
how_to_see_it: Run and change sonar distance from 100 cm to 20 cm; no readings appear.

root_cause: The LCD SDA wire goes to Uno A5 and SCL goes to A4, reversing the I2C bus.
fix: Connect LCD SDA to A4 and SCL to A5.
how_to_see_it: Start simulation and check that the expected text never appears.

root_cause: The ADC wire is connected to the potentiometer supply terminal instead of its SIG wiper.
fix: Move only the GPIO34 wire from pot:VCC to pot:SIG, retaining supply and ground.
how_to_see_it: Turn the knob across its full travel; GPIO34 keeps reading the supply rail.

root_cause: A five-second blocking delay prevents the sketch from sampling short button presses.
fix: Remove the delay or sample the button frequently using a nonblocking millis schedule.
how_to_see_it: Tap for 200 ms between the five-second samples; then hold the button for over five seconds.

root_cause: lastBlink is reset on every loop before elapsed time is checked, so 500 ms never accumulates.
fix: Remove the unconditional lastBlink assignment at the start of loop; update it only after a blink.
how_to_see_it: Run for ten seconds; the LED stays off.

root_cause: raw / 1023 uses integer division before assignment to float, discarding every fractional value.
how_to_see_it: Rotate from minimum through midpoint to maximum; observe only 0 and 100.

root_cause: The sketch toggles repeatedly for the entire LOW level rather than once on the press edge; bounce is disabled.
fix: Track the previous button state and toggle only on the HIGH-to-LOW transition.
how_to_see_it: Hold the button for one second; the LED toggles about ten times.
